name: CRC Maesta
description: Super-premium G+33 residential towers offering the lowest density layout with only 2 apartments per floor in Sector 1.
long_description: CRC Maesta is a super-premium, under-construction residential development located in the ultra-prime Sector 1, Noida Extension (Greater Noida West). Spanning approximately 3.6 acres of land, this high-end gated community features 5 iconic high-rise towers soaring up to G+33 floors, housing a total of only 358 exclusive residences. Designed for buyers who demand absolute privacy and spaciousness, the project represents the lowest-density development in the region, offering only 2 apartments per floor. Built to high specifications, Maesta offers grand 3 BHK and 4 BHK layouts, each providing 270-degree panoramic green views. The central community highlights a palatial 26,000 sq ft clubhouse, a temperature-controlled indoor swimming pool, high-tech wellness gyms, a dedicated buggy-friendly pathway, and a no-vehicular walking zone, located just 5 minutes drive over the Hindon Bridge to central Noida.
address: Plot No. GH-11B, Sector 1, Bisrakh Jalalpur, Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh 201306
